title: Correct lichen-link build_frame output buffer contract
description: The public documentation for LinkLayer::build_frame in rust/lichen-link/src/link_layer.rs says the output buffer must be at least inner_payload.len() + 53 bytes. The encoded signed frame actually needs payload + destination length + 61 bytes (1 length byte + 4 fixed header bytes + 8 signer EUI-64 bytes + 48 signature bytes, in addition to destination and payload). Callers following the documented contract receive BufferTooSmall. Document the exact required size, ideally with a checked helper/test.
